settings.headline: Professional is the highest strength in the system.
settings.body: Developed with practitioners and available without restriction. Most clients choose Clinical for routine work; Advanced is the higher-strength step for longer or more sensitive sessions.

settings.title: Start with clean, dry skin.
settings.body: Remove make-up, oil or moisturiser so nothing sits between the product and the skin.

settings.title: Apply a thick, visible layer.
settings.body: Let it sit on the surface rather than rubbing it in. Customers who get the best results typically report a generous layer — thick enough to look visibly white on the skin.

settings.title: Cover the area.
settings.body: A layer of cling film (or a similar occlusive cover) keeps it in contact with the skin while it takes effect.

settings.title: Leave it on to take effect.
settings.body: As a general guide, cream is applied around 45–60 minutes before your appointment — this varies, so follow the product guidance and your practitioner.

settings.title: Remove before your appointment.
settings.body: Wipe away with a clean cloth or tissue, or as your practitioner directs.

settings.headline: How to apply.
settings.lead:
Before you apply: patch test a small amount 24 hours ahead — inside the wrist or behind the ear. If you see redness, irritation or swelling, don't use it.

Take extra care on sensitive, broken or irritated skin. If your practitioner applies their own numbing, check with them first rather than doubling up.

settings.label: Strength
settings.value: Professional — the highest strength in the Senseless system. Cream format.

settings.question: How long before my appointment should I apply it?
settings.answer: As a general guide, around 45–60 minutes ahead. It varies with the product and the appointment, so follow the product guidance and your practitioner.

settings.question: How long does it last?
settings.answer: It comes down to three things: which strength you've chosen, how well it was applied — a thick layer, covered, left long enough — and how long and demanding the appointment is. Coverage fades gradually rather than stopping suddenly, so matching the strength to the appointment is what keeps it lasting as long as you need.

settings.question: Do I need to patch test?
settings.answer: Yes — a small amount 24 hours ahead, on the wrist or behind the ear. If there's any reaction, don't use it.

settings.question: Can I apply it the night before?
settings.answer: No — it has a short window. Apply on the day, within the guidance above.

settings.question: What size should I choose?
settings.answer: 10g suits a single appointment or a first try; 30g suits regular bookings or larger areas.

settings.question: What's in it?
settings.answer: A UK cosmetic topical preparation by Matrix Health Group Ltd. The full ingredient list is on the pack — patch test first if you have known sensitivities.

settings.question: When is Professional the right choice?
settings.answer: Professional is the highest strength in the system, developed with practitioners and available without restriction. Most appointments are well served by Clinical, with Advanced for longer or more sensitive work; Professional is for the most demanding sessions.

settings.question: Is this a medicine?
settings.answer: No. A UK cosmetic product, not a medicine.
